cohort: Newborns (term, preterm, or post-term) with history of perinatal asphyxia or an APGAR score at 5 minutes < 7, or delayed crying after birth, or > 10 minutes of resuscitation born at Nazeer Hussain Medical Complex, Hyderabad, excluding those with lethal anomalies.
finding: Grade 1 HIE was the most common (41.5%), followed by Grade 2, and Grade 3 was the least common, but had the highest mortality rate (21.9%).
mod_finding: 56.1% of neonates were born by C-section.
